name: v6-elastic-net-py
description: Federated Elastic Net for feature selection on high-dimensional methylation data (p >> n). Exact federation via sufficient statistics (Gram matrix X^T X and X^T y).

functions.name: central
functions.description: Coordinator: aggregates sufficient statistics from all nodes and solves Elastic Net by coordinate descent. Returns coefficients and selected CpGs.

databases.name: methylation
databases.description: Beta-value matrix: CpG columns + binary outcome

arguments.name: input_source
arguments.description: 'Result of a previous task': this run uses the result of the task you give below. 'Upload my own file': upload a JSON file instead, e.g. for different data.

arguments.name: candidates_task_id
arguments.description: Id of a finished DMP/DMR task (its top DMPs found in all hospitals) or Beta and M values task (the probes with the largest difference between the chosen cohorts, full coverage), shown on its task page Leave empty to use the most recent finished DMP/DMR or Beta and M values task of this session; the result's Input table shows which one was used.

arguments.name: n_candidates
arguments.description: How many candidate CpGs to take from that task

arguments.name: features
arguments.description: A JSON list of candidate CpG IDs (at most 2,000), e.g. ["cg14697761_TC21", "cg08640252_TC11"]; only those available in every hospital are used

arguments.name: outcome_column
arguments.description: Outcome column: numeric (e.g. age), or text with positive_value (e.g. cohort)

arguments.name: alpha
arguments.description: Regularization strength

arguments.name: l1_ratio
arguments.description: Balance L1/L2 (1=Lasso, 0=Ridge)

arguments.name: max_iter
arguments.description: Max coordinate-descent iterations

arguments.name: tol
arguments.description: Convergence threshold

arguments.name: min_samples
arguments.description: Privacy guard: skip nodes with fewer samples

arguments.name: warn_gram_gb
arguments.description: Warn if the p×p Gram matrix exceeds this size

arguments.name: center_by
arguments.description: 'hospital' (default: one intercept per hospital, removes batch between hospitals), 'hospital_cohort' (one intercept per hospital x cohort) or 'global' (original)

arguments.name: cohort_column
arguments.description: Column holding the cohort of each sample (needed for 'hospital_cohort' or cohorts)

arguments.name: cohorts
arguments.description: Cohorts to include; empty = all

arguments.name: sample_column
arguments.description: Sample column when the input is long format (probe_id, sample, value)

arguments.name: value_column
arguments.description: Value column (e.g. 'beta' or 'm_value') when the input is long format

arguments.name: positive_value
arguments.description: For a text outcome such as the cohort: outcome = 1 for this value, 0 otherwise. Empty with two cohorts: the second cohort is the positive one; empty with three or more cohorts: one model per cohort against the others (one-vs-rest) and the union of the selected CpGs

arguments.name: organizations_to_include
arguments.description: Hospitals (organizations) to use; empty = all of the collaboration

ui_visualizations.name: Input
ui_visualizations.description: Where this run's input came from

ui_visualizations.name: Selected CpGs
ui_visualizations.description: CpGs with a non-zero coefficient, largest first (one-vs-rest: with the cohorts that selected them)

ui_visualizations.name: Excluded CpGs
ui_visualizations.description: Candidate CpGs not available in every hospital

functions.name: partial_moments
functions.description: Per-node: local sums/sums-of-squares for global standardization. Returns aggregates only.
